entries.title: Dedicated /loren page, home redesign, saved conversations
bullets: /loren is now a dedicated always-on page — just visit yoursite.com/loren, no key, no digging in Lovable.
Home redesign: full-width (dead margins gone), big tool cards with large on-brand icons and consistent gradient styling.

Conversations are saved like ChatGPT/Claude — auto-named threads. A new Chats list (rail) shows them all, and Jump back in on the home reopens your recent ones. Threads reopen at /loren/c/:id and continue where you left off.
Next: inline property profile (click a listing → prev/next in the conversation), then the Activity + Projects surfaces.
entries.bench: dedicated page · full-width home · big cards · saved + reopenable threads · 0 existing files modified

entries.title: Fast direct-mount search, pagination, full-width
bullets: Removed the iframe that re-booted the whole app (the 20-30s); direct-mount renders in ~1-2s with real pagination, full-width.

bullets: Page is the single source of truth; Sharpie highlighter + gradient links; orb larger than the photo with movement everywhere.

entries.title: Real product UI inline; full search page embedded; formatted replies; credits
bullets: Search renders via your actual components / full page; markdown replies; credits per turn + session total.
